
import json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,sys,time
cfg=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);os.chdir(cfg['workdir'])
nonce=cfg['nonce'];root=pathlib.Path.cwd();trace=root/('.s0-'+nonce+'.jsonl')
go=root/('.s0-'+nonce+'.go');release=root/('.s0-'+nonce+'.release')
def event(kind,**kw):
 data=dict(event=kind,mono=time.monotonic(),wall_ns=time.time_ns(),pid=os.getpid(),nonce=nonce,**kw)
 raw=(json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
 fd=os.open(trace,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_APPEND,0o600)
 try:os.write(fd,raw);os.fsync(fd)
 finally:os.close(fd)
 print('STEP0 '+json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
event('ready',mode=cfg['mode'],tty=os.isatty(1))
deadline=time.monotonic()+cfg['watchdog']
while not go.exists():
 if time.monotonic()>deadline:event('fixture_watchdog',phase='before_go');sys.exit(97)
 time.sleep(.02)
if cfg['mode']=='control':event('main_exiting',exit=23);os._exit(23)
parent=os.getpid();rd,wr=os.pipe();child=os.fork()
if child==0:
 os.close(rd)
 if cfg['mode']!='ordinary':signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP,signal.SIG_IGN);os.setsid()
 if cfg['mode']=='detached':
  fd=os.open(os.devnull,os.O_RDWR)
  for target in [0,1,2]:os.dup2(fd,target)
  if fd>2:os.close(fd)
 server=None
 try:
  if cfg['mode']=='codex':
   home=root/('.codex-step0-'+nonce);home.mkdir(mode=0o700)
   env=dict(os.environ,CODEX_HOME=str(home))
   version=subprocess.run(['codex','--version'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
   event('codex_version',exit=version.returncode,version=version.stdout.strip())
   endpoint='unix://'+str(root/('.s0-'+nonce+'.sock'))
   server=subprocess.Popen(['codex','app-server','--listen',endpoint],env=env,
     stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
   event('appserver_started',server_pid=server.pid)
   socket_path=pathlib.Path(endpoint.removeprefix('unix://'))
   limit=time.monotonic()+cfg['watchdog']
   while not socket_path.is_socket() and server.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<limit:time.sleep(.02)
   event('appserver_readiness',socket_ready=socket_path.is_socket(),exit=server.poll())
  own_stat=[]
  if cfg['mode']=='ordinary':
   try:own_stat=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
   except OSError:pass
  event('child_ready',parent=parent,tty=os.isatty(1),ppid=os.getppid(),
    pgid=os.getpgrp(),sid=os.getsid(0),parent_pgid=os.getpgid(parent),parent_sid=os.getsid(parent),
    sighup=str(signal.getsignal(signal.SIGHUP)),start_ticks=own_stat[19] if own_stat else None)
  os.write(wr,b'1');os.close(wr)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+cfg['watchdog']
  while os.getppid()==parent and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(.01)
  if os.getppid()==parent:
   event('fixture_watchdog',phase='parent_reparenting')
  else:
   event('parent_gone',parent=parent,ppid=os.getppid(),tty=os.isatty(1),
     appserver_exit=None if server is None else server.poll())
   while not release.exists() and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(.02)
   event('child_releasing',released=release.exists(),tty=os.isatty(1),
     appserver_exit=None if server is None else server.poll())
 finally:
  if server is not None:
   if server.poll() is None:
    os.killpg(server.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    try:server.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(server.pid,signal.SIGKILL);server.wait()
   event('appserver_settled',exit=server.returncode)
  event('child_exiting')
 os._exit(0)
os.close(wr)
if os.read(rd,1)!=b'1':event('child_start_failed');sys.exit(96)
os.close(rd);event('main_exiting',child=child,exit=23);os._exit(23)
